CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.
   B. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.
   C. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Background of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Use Background of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background of Prophet Amos.
   D. Say Background of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   D. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.
   B. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .
   B. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings of Prophet Amos.
   C. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   D. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Galilean Ministry 2.4 Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians 3.0 Church in Actio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Galilean Ministry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Spirit 3.2 The Gifts of the Holy Spirit 3.3 The Holy Trinity 3.4 Sacram and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. D — Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. A — Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Galilean Ministry 2.4 Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians 3.0 Church in Actio; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Holy Spirit 3.2 The Gifts of the Holy Spirit 3.3 The Holy Trinity 3.4 Sacram; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
